summary: Full first-pass test of Ambajogai Grocery MVP. Backend: 36 pytest cases across auth/OTP/products/categories/orders/admin — all passed (100%). Frontend: tested home, search, category nav, products filters/sort, product detail, cart, register/login, unauth checkout redirect, checkout (UPI QR + COD), order detail tracker, my orders, full admin CRUD (products, categories, order status), contact WhatsApp, legal pages. Two significant frontend bugs found: (1) cart is wiped from localStorage on any hard page reload/direct URL load, (2) after placing an order the user lands on /cart instead of /orders/<id>.

minor.issue: No rate limiting / brute-force lockout — 6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 with no throttling (429 never returned).
Prices/stock are trusted from the client payload; server does not re-fetch product price or validate stock availability, so totals can be manipulated by a crafted request.
Raw ObjectId(id) conversion without try/except → invalid id string raises 500 instead of 400/404. DELETE also returns success:true for non-existent ids.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: cart is lost on every hard reload / direct URL entry. The persist effect (useEffect(...,[items])) writes the initial empty array to localStorage on mount before the hydration effect's setItems commits, overwriting 'ambajogai_cart' with []. Verified: add item -> localStorage has 1 item -> page.reload() -> localStorage = '[]' and cart page shows empty. Fix: hydrate with a lazy useState initializer (useState(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]'))) or guard the writer with a 'hydrated' ref.

HIGH: after a successful order the app navigates to /cart instead of /orders/<id>. clearCart() empties items and the finally-block setSubmitting(false) lets the guard effect (items.length===0 && !submitting -> navigate('/cart')) fire after navigate(`/orders/${id}`). Order IS created correctly (verified in My Orders + API). Fix: set a 'placed' flag / skip the redirect effect once an order has been submitted.

Form inputs (Name, Slug, Price, MRP, Unit, Image URL, Stock, Category select) have no data-testid — only the modal container and save button do. Same for the category form. Makes automated testing brittle.
Category delete uses native window.confirm() instead of a shadcn AlertDialog; also 'Add category' button has no data-testid.

issues: No image preview or URL validation for the image field; a bad URL silently renders a broken image (observed ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED console errors for some image hosts).

action_items: Fix cart localStorage hydration in CartContext.jsx (cart currently lost on every refresh) — CRITICAL
Fix post-order navigation in Checkout.jsx so the user lands on /orders/<id> instead of /cart
Recompute order item prices server-side from DB and validate stock in POST /api/orders
Wrap ObjectId() conversions in try/except (products PUT/DELETE, categories DELETE) to return 400/404 instead of 500
Add data-testid to admin product/category form fields
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext: writer effect runs before hydration state commits — classic localStorage wipe bug; use lazy state init.
Checkout: navigate() is overridden by the empty-cart guard effect; guard needs an 'orderPlaced' flag.
server.py is 748 lines — split into routers (auth, products, orders, admin) for maintainability.
POST /api/orders trusts client-supplied prices — price/stock must be resolved server-side.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: pytest /app/backend/tests -v). All backend endpoints verified incl. delivery fee rules (<499 -> 30, >=499 -> 0), stock decrement, RBAC (403 for customer on admin routes), order ownership (403 cross-user), status transitions and history. Frontend: product cards swap the 'Add' button for an increment/decrement stepper after the first add — use [data-testid=increment-<slug>] for the 2nd+ unit. Products sort select values are featured|price-asc|price-desc|name. Cart survives SPA navigation but NOT a hard reload (bug). Verify both fixes with a reload-based test.
rca_of_the_issue: Cart wipe: in CartProvider, useState([]) + useEffect(persist,[items]) runs the persist effect on first commit with the empty default before the hydration effect's setItems is applied, so localStorage is overwritten with '[]' on every full page load. Post-order redirect: Checkout's guard effect `if (items.length === 0 && !submitting) navigate('/cart')` re-fires after clearCart() + setSubmitting(false) in the finally block, superseding navigate('/orders/<id>').
